info.title: Sovereign Bunny Gateway & RPC Proxy JSON-RPC 2.0 API
info.description: Standard Web3 JSON-RPC 2.0 interface alongside Low-Entropy System Address Contracts (EIP-1352) and Sovereign Daemon Fast-Path Extensions (bunny_*).

servers.name: Local Gateway Ingress
servers.description: L7 JSON-RPC endpoint transcoding RLP/JSON into 4-byte framed SSZ envelopes

servers.name: High-Performance RPC Read Proxy
servers.description: Synthetic receipts and 48-hour hot state read cache

methods.name: eth_sendRawTransaction
methods.summary: Submits an RLP or SSZ encoded raw transaction to standard contracts or low-entropy system addresses
methods.description: Routes standard EVM transactions or SSZ envelopes into partition queues. When targeting low-entropy system addresses (0x01..0x0A, 0x100) or virtual chain addresses (0x00..01<ChainID>), system decoders execute native logic without extra RPC overhead.

params.name: signedTxData
params.description: Hex-encoded raw transaction bytecode (RLP EIP-2718 or SSZ with 0x424e5901 header)

methods.name: eth_call
methods.summary: Executes a message call transaction immediately without creating a transaction on the ledger
methods.description: Executes EVM bytecode or queries low-entropy system contracts (e.g. querying DID registry at 0x00...03, account height at 0x00...0100, or virtual chain state at 0x00..01<ChainID>).

to.description: Target address or low-entropy system address (e.g. 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000003)

methods.name: eth_blockNumber
methods.summary: Returns the latest finalized epoch height or block number

methods.name: eth_getBalance
methods.summary: Returns the balance of the account at specified block/epoch height

methods.name: bunny_resolveDid
methods.summary: Off-chain / P2P Fast-Path: Resolves a W3C DID document across 11 cryptographic and post-quantum curves
methods.description: Fast-path daemon query. On-chain contracts can alternatively call eth_call targeting SYSTEM_DID_REGISTRY (0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000003).

params.name: didUri
params.description: W3C DID URI string (e.g. did:peer:4... or did:sovereign:...)

methods.name: bunny_simulateSagaIntent
methods.summary: Daemon Fast-Path Simulation: Simulates cross-chain 2PC Saga intents or Reverse Shadow contract execution in RAM
methods.description: Directly invokes the stateless execution worker to simulate escrow lockups, gas costs, and nullifiers without on-chain state mutations. For on-chain settlement, dispatch transactions to SYSTEM_SAGA_ESCROW (0x04) or SYSTEM_BRIDGE (0x06).

methods.name: bunny_queryStorageCid
methods.summary: Off-chain / IPFS Fast-Path: Queries storage availability and BLAKE3 Bao CID proof for a given state root
methods.description: Queries the Storage Daemon directly over P2P/Iroh for data availability and retrievability status.

methods.name: bunny_resolveZkDns
methods.summary: Resolves a domain name to IP or WireGuard public key via stateless SMT proof
methods.description: Blinded subdomain query resolved in <1µs from in-memory Sparse Merkle Trees without exposing DNS lookup queries to recursive resolvers.

methods.name: bunny_submitZkOidcAuth
methods.summary: Authenticates a Web2 OIDC token inside a Noir ZK circuit without disclosing PII
methods.description: Verifies client-side Noir UltraHonk proof of Google/Apple JWT. Binds an ephemeral session key and unlocks native Paymaster gas sponsorship.

methods.name: bunny_verifyZkCompliance
methods.summary: Evaluates a Noir zkCompliance predicate for X-Road regulatory audit
methods.description: Evaluates selective disclosure assertions (TaxLiability, Solvency, SanctionsNonMembership) without leaking underlying account state.
